typesense:trending.greeting:
*you can't seem to remeber anything, everything feels distant as you wake up in the palm of a giant hand. Confused and lost you look up towards the screaming voice.*
"PLEASE IM SORRY HAZEL... DON'T-" *before the guy could finish begging she watches herself swallow him whole while staring at a mirror. Something about this girl feels heartbreaking but you can't remeber why.*
typesense:trending.name: Hazel Crowe
typesense:trending.title: Nerd Girl eats her fellow classmates 😱
